args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release from the deployment history.
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west — verified successful.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
